purpose: Transfer the original JANUS state-advancing 5D Spiral to local radio-spectrum evidence verification, isolate the contribution of Spiral from Penrose and preserve exact frozen Minimal Hybrid reference. Distinguish search guidance from evidence and count every suppression as a decision even if called abstention.

r41b.required: completed/success plus authenticated final result with 11/11 exact parity, 22 processes, zero paired losses and immutable lock

r41p.required: completed/success plus authenticated final result with 11/11 full-bank score/path/decision parity; preserve negative timing outcomes and prefix losses

parent_gate.action: Before numerical implementation or execution, bind immutable final artifacts by run ID, artifact ID, full archive SHA256, result hash, source commit, data hashes and lock hash. If either fails or is incomplete, HOLD; no silent fallback or replacement. Scientific HOLD is compatible with engineering benchmark, not scientific adoption. No launch on prerequisite completion alone: explicitly verify receipts.

frozen_data.scope: Historical viewed synthetic injections on actual observed backgrounds only. Six original fit groups not independent; five original audit groups are also already viewed. No new physical transmitter labels. Never treat previously viewed rows as blind tests.

frozen_rules.trigger: All frozen Minimal Hybrid output alerts, including parent and joint-rescue lanes, regardless of outcome label, target, injection type, weakness or truth path. No trigger based on lost positives or knowledge of which 53 rows are controls. Include ordinary and shared challenge rows. Non-alerts remain unchanged; no recovery experiment mixed with suppression.
frozen_rules.fail_open: On missing/ambiguous metadata, unsupported path, contradictory evidence, exhausted budget or invalid provenance, retain baseline alert and record HOLD. Never turn missing data into negative evidence. Explicitly log every alert removed; a HOLD cannot cosmetically reduce counts.
frozen_rules.checkpoint: State hash is derived from evidence content, bounds, unresolved alternatives and immutable source IDs; not wall clock, turn number or rephrasing. A repeated state is NO_INFORMATION_GAIN and halts. Preserve all failed branches, source hashes, causal dependency edges, anchor, parent hash and decision mask. No automatic source-target claims.
frozen_rules.provenance: ON/OFF or independent scan means physically distinct measured scan with validated role, time, signed native frequency and channel grid. Synthetic injected examples are labeled only for evaluation; no deployment claims. No invented bins, wrapping, extrapolation, or retrocausal interpretation.

budget.repeat_exact_store_by: raw input hash, scan role, path, legal support, operator version
budget.count_all: Full attempted computations including cache misses, validation, source lookup, hash and branch scheduling. Identical input preparation and hardware, report reused cache separately.

dimensions.operator: On fixed native path, deterministic disjoint time-block fit and held-out replay in both directions, including swapped halves. Reverse ordering alone is not new evidence; choose competitors only on training block. Record held-out margins, legal support and disagreements; no using ground truth.

Compare raw measured ON/OFF at same native frequency and fixed legal rival bank; independent alternate paths chosen without audit labels. Retain shared ON/OFF as ambiguous unless stronger disjoint evidence exists.
Coarse context for navigation only; verify against original native bins with exact source hash; compare neighboring legal basins and wider native halo where supported. No loss of original resolution.

Enumerate predefined rival/control hypotheses (noise, narrow-band coherent alternative, shared/background structure, edge effect) and update or retain them only using measured evidence. Preserve contradictions and previously tested branches, reuse exact cached evaluations.

Verify source tiles, independent ON/OFF scan identity, physical time/frequency alignment, support and evidence receipt; provenance limits final decision. Confirmed evidence from a new disjoint observation is distinct from multiple scores on same data.

decision_prespec.primary: C0 is advisory-only state-advancing orchestration and exact baseline parity; no change in alerts by definition. C1 is a separately frozen, single strict experimental veto rule; no search over individual residuals. Implement and hash numerical operator/veto contract before any new R41S outcome is examined; use existing frozen thresholds and explicit prespecified conservative physical margins, not test-set fitted quantiles.
decision_prespec.constraint: Veto requires independently sourced corroboration and a competing explanation supported on disjoint held-out time blocks plus independently mapped scans. Neither common ON/OFF recurrence, direction disagreement, a higher rival score, edge proximity, nor multiple correlated features alone may veto. For Joint Min rescue, same gate applies with stricter default retention of unresolved shared signals. All disagreements and unsupported cases fail open.
decision_prespec.quantitative_contract_status: HOLD_PREIMPLEMENTATION: exact numerical veto thresholds and scan matching tolerances must be frozen in R41S1 independent of R41S outputs; this file freezes scope, budget, operators, design and gate; it is not a claim that a working numerical operator has already been implemented.

variants.name: Minimal + Penrose
variants.rule: Exact Penrose bank completion; identical outputs required, use eight-orbit darkfill with fixed canonical tie rule. Bounded Penrose tested separately as engineering diagnostic, not used for primary suppression.

variants.name: Minimal + 5D advisory
variants.rule: State-advancing local operator, preserve all baseline alerts, check implementation parity, information-gain and cost.

variants.name: Minimal + 5D Spiral
variants.rule: Canonical exact rivals where required, same frozen A, same preregistered local rule C1. Run and freeze C result after A; never modify model/thresholds.

variants.name: Minimal + Penrose + 5D Spiral
variants.rule: Only after C outputs have been sealed, swap canonical search order to B exact Penrose with exact outputs. Same C rule, operator, trigger, budget and sources. D-C measures efficiency under strict parity; any changes mean failed equivalence. A separately preregistered bounded D can be considered later if independently justified.

stage_order.gate: Freeze this contract, preserve parent experiments.
Both final authenticated receipts; freeze numerical operator/veto and synthetic/adversarial selftests, verify label-blind routing.
A exact reference; C0/C no fit; 11 paired groups, independent process cost and per-group checkpoints. Preserve C lock and all negative outcomes.
No combined run before C result is sealed. B versus A exact; D versus C exact (same decision rule), full accounting.
External fresh data and independent custodian; production decision separate.

primary: paired positive losses vs A and Joint Min
control alerts overall and per lane
cost: per-group paired ratio and aggregate totals

gates.engineering: 11/11 exact A parity; C0 equality; independent selftest of no-information-gain, source invalidation, veto fail-open and disjoint control selection. No label access for routing.
gates.historical_screen: C must preserve all 205 ordinary +113 shared, 31+38 weak, zero paired loss vs R40G and Joint Min, zero additional stress losses across 119 cases, <=35/640 controls and <=7/8 Learned05 (64 on same 5 audit groups). Compare counts independently in operational and common-support where meaningful. No new scientific winner if fails any. C exact preserved baseline is not improvement unless controls reduced. <=35 is screening threshold, not new evidence.
gates.relative_goal: 18 additional controls removed versus 53, keep parent and rescue results separate. No numerical gain promised.
gates.penrose_isolation: B must duplicate A and D must duplicate C if all exact search outputs and operator decisions are unchanged. Report time benefit independently. Do not use D if C does not establish valid operator parity.
gates.adoption: HOLD even on historical gate pass until independent fresh observations, matched realized false-alert burden and full cost comparison to existing native algorithms, independently blinded evaluation and explicit adoption. R28 working version unchanged.
